backend/main.mo: Main actor managing access control, user profiles, hydration logs, and Stripe-powered paid access with admin configuration and session handling.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old hydration data to a new structure with timestamps and initializing new state fields including access control and paid users.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to related frontend files, components, and requirement IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files related to authentication, payments, routing, and hydration tracking UI.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style definitions including OKLCH color tokens and theme variables for light and dark mode.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document bootstrapping the app with a mount point and main script import.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling authentication, paywall routing, and tabbed UI for daily logging and weekly summaries.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with React Query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/features/payments/component: UI component showing a cancelled payment message with options to retry or return to the app.
Handles payment confirmation via session_id, displays success or error state, and redirects to home.
frontend/src/features/payments/hooks/use: Mutation hook that calls actor.confirmPurchase and invalidates paidAccess on success.
Creates a Stripe checkout session through the actor and returns the session URL for redirection.
frontend/src/features/paywall/PaywallScr: Paywall UI that requires login and starts a checkout session to unlock app access.
frontend/src/features/water/components/W: Widget for logging daily water intake, showing weekly data, and handling payment-required errors.
Displays weekly water intake stats and triggers payment-required handling on access errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actors, refetching dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, loading saved identities and providing login/logout functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/usePaidAccess.ts: React Query hook that checks if the current actor has paid access and exposes loading and access flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks to fetch the weekly summary and record intake, handling actor availability and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining light and dark theme color variables and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/paymentErrors.ts: Utilities to detect payment-required backend errors and generate user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, radius, animations, and enabling typography and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing features, paywall requirements, and pending architectural requests.
